tasks.label: Restart server (dev)
tasks.command: Get-Process -Id (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).OwningProcess | Stop-Process -Force; $env:NODE_ENV='development'; node server.js

tasks.label: Hard restart server (dev)
tasks.command: Get-Process -Name node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; $env:NODE_ENV='development'; node server.js
